title: Pattern Breaking — Fast Fashion's Dirty Tricks
summary: A research-led editorial site that combines statistics, deceptive-interface examples, and policy chronology into one continuous argument.

interaction_model.response: Successive evidence modes—data, examples, explanation, and chronology—advance the same argument.

transfer_constraints: Borrow the sequencing logic: change representation when the argument needs a different kind of evidence.
Keep evidence modes tied to one narrative question rather than turning them into independent dashboard widgets.
fidelity_constraints: Preserve the editorial/evidence relationship without copying Fast Fashion branding, copy, statistics, or illustrations.
failure_modes: Do not infer the original implementation stack from the visual result.
Do not reduce the mechanism to decorative scroll animation without the evidence structure.

title: Whole Earth Index
summary: A long-form publication archive where publication families and issue chronology remain directly visible as the navigation surface.

interaction_model.response: Publication families and dated issues remain exposed, allowing direct scanning and selection without leaving the corpus view.

transfer_constraints: Keep archive structure visible enough that users can understand scope before opening an item.
Use chronology and publication grouping as navigation primitives rather than converting every issue into an isolated card.
fidelity_constraints: Preserve the archive/index logic without copying publication artwork or editorial assets.
failure_modes: Do not equate density with poor hierarchy; the visible corpus structure is the mechanism.
Do not infer implementation technology from the rendered site.

title: Fiona Vilmer — cultural portfolio archive
summary: A restrained text-led corpus organized by Curating, Texts, Publications, and Programming/Talks, with metadata-rich project detail.

interaction_model.trigger: browse categories and open an indexed entry
interaction_model.response: The corpus stays legible as a categorized body of work while detail pages expose dates, credits, publication information, and images.

transfer_constraints: Keep category structure and work metadata primary; project imagery should enrich rather than replace the corpus index.
Let detail pages remain connected to the larger archive instead of behaving like isolated campaign pages.
fidelity_constraints: Preserve the corpus-first editorial structure without copying names, project imagery, or cultural-institution identities.
failure_modes: Do not claim unobserved transition or interaction behavior.
Do not turn the archive into a conventional image-card portfolio.

title: Severance — title sequence
summary: A 3D sequence that uses duplication, soft-body deformation, impossible bodily states, and spatial discontinuity to materialize the idea of split identity.

interaction_model.response: Repeated transformations and spatial contradictions accumulate into a continuous metaphor for divided identity.

transfer_constraints: Start from the abstract idea, then choose spatial/physical transformations that embody it consistently.
Maintain recognizable subject identity across deformation so metaphor survives the spectacle.
fidelity_constraints: Borrow the semantic transformation logic, not the Severance character, imagery, sequence, or title treatment.
failure_modes: Do not treat generic 3D distortion as equivalent to semantic metaphor.
Do not infer that the documented film toolchain is required for a frontend adaptation.

title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse — title sequence
summary: A mixed-media title sequence fusing 3D-derived scenes with halftone, spray paint, offset-print color, scanned illustration, hand drawing, and typography.

interaction_model.response: Material languages are layered and recombined over motion so print/comic surface behavior remains active inside animated spatial scenes.

transfer_constraints: Use materially distinct surface systems intentionally—e.g. print offset, drawn marks, halftone, paint—not as one generic texture layer.
Keep surface treatments tied to hierarchy, impact, or world logic across the motion sequence.
fidelity_constraints: Preserve the principle of mixed material languages without copying Spider-Man characters, comic assets, marks, or branded type.
failure_modes: Do not flatten mixed-media construction into a single noise overlay.
Do not infer the exact source asset pipeline beyond the documented process.

title: Uncut Gems — opening/title sequence
summary: A continuous camera movement enters an opal, traverses imagined microscopic/cosmic interiors, and connects material space to organic bodily imagery without a hard semantic break.

interaction_model.response: A sustained push-in and changing depth/material cues preserve continuity as scale and semantic context transform.

transfer_constraints: Use camera continuity and material/depth cues to bridge scales instead of hiding the change behind a cut.
Preserve a directional visual thread across the transition so the viewer understands one space becoming another.
fidelity_constraints: Borrow the continuous scale-transition logic without copying the opal imagery, bodily imagery, film titles, or soundtrack.
failure_modes: Do not confuse semantic scale transition with ordinary image zoom.
Do not assert undocumented software or rendering methods.

title: Beyoncé — Formation Tour stage
summary: A stage dominated by a monumental image volume whose presence makes the display itself a scenic object, focal field, divider, and reveal device.

interaction_model.response: The central display object changes the spatial reading of the stage rather than functioning as a passive backdrop.

transfer_constraints: Treat one dominant visual surface as a spatial actor that can frame, divide, reveal, or conceal content.
Let scale and placement establish hierarchy before adding smaller interface layers.
fidelity_constraints: Preserve the display-as-scenery principle without copying Beyoncé imagery, tour content, choreography, or stage assets.
failure_modes: Do not infer undocumented stage mechanics.
Do not reduce the reference to 'large video background'; its spatial role is the useful mechanism.

title: Mirror Maze — Peckham 2016
summary: An immersive mirrored maze in which repeated planes and reflections multiply perceived space, partial views, and navigational ambiguity.

interaction_model.response: Changing position alters reflected paths, apparent depth, self-location, and partial visibility, making navigation itself part of the composition.

transfer_constraints: Translate reflection/repetition at the mechanism level: duplicated views, partial visibility, uncertain orientation, and path-dependent perception.
Use navigation or viewpoint change to reveal spatial relationships rather than using mirrors only as decoration.
fidelity_constraints: Preserve the spatial/perceptual principle without copying the physical installation layout, imagery, or audio.
failure_modes: Do not imply a web adaptation should literally reproduce the installation.
Do not infer unverified construction or projection technology.

title: U2 — The Sphere / Nevada Ark contribution
summary: An environment-scale display context where the enclosing visual surface operates as the scene itself rather than as a framed screen behind it.

interaction_model.trigger: experience or watch the environment-scale display
interaction_model.response: The enclosing image field changes the perceived world around the audience, collapsing background, screen, and spatial envelope.

transfer_constraints: Treat the viewport/environment as a field that can replace the surrounding context, not merely contain a centered composition.
Design for the viewer's field of attention and scale before adding conventional interface framing.
fidelity_constraints: Use only the environment-as-display principle; do not attribute all Sphere content or engineering to Es Devlin or copy U2 imagery.
failure_modes: Do not overstate Es Devlin's authorship beyond the documented contribution.
Do not equate immersion with simply filling a screen edge-to-edge.

title: CATK — kinetic identity system
summary: A flexible typographic identity designed to operate coherently in both motion and print while supporting, rather than overpowering, the underlying work.

interaction_model.response: The same identity rules remain recognizable as typography shifts between still and time-based contexts.

transfer_constraints: Define motion and typographic behavior as system rules that survive both static and animated contexts.
Allow the identity to support content rather than requiring maximum motion in every application.
fidelity_constraints: Preserve rule continuity across media without copying CATK marks, copy, layouts, or proprietary identity assets.
failure_modes: Do not reduce kinetic identity to one logo animation.
Do not infer implementation software not stated by the source.

title: Nike Statement House — experiential typographic identity
summary: An experiential identity distributed across court and screens, with high-energy typographic animation rules derived from basketball movement.

interaction_model.response: Typographic motion takes behavioral cues from basketball movement and propagates one identity across multiple spatial surfaces.

transfer_constraints: Derive motion vocabulary from the subject's real movement or behavior instead of selecting arbitrary easing.
Coordinate distributed surfaces as one identity system rather than independent screens.
fidelity_constraints: Borrow the movement-derived system logic without copying Nike branding, campaign assets, type treatment, or spatial installation.
failure_modes: Do not use sports-like velocity as generic decoration without a source behavior.
Do not infer technical synchronization details not documented by the case study.

title: A-Trak — scalable live visual identity
summary: A typographic identity system whose parameters support restrained website/flyer expressions and much more maximal album/live-show visuals without changing identity language.

interaction_model.response: The same typographic/motion grammar expands or contracts in intensity to match web, print, album, and live contexts.

transfer_constraints: Design identity parameters with a usable intensity range instead of creating separate visual languages for quiet and maximal contexts.
Keep invariant rules visible even when scale, density, and motion amplitude change.
fidelity_constraints: Preserve the scalable-system principle without copying A-Trak typography, artwork, live visuals, or music identity.
failure_modes: Do not equate flexibility with uncontrolled stylistic variation.
Do not infer specific implementation software from the public case study.
